role: Writes the full game state at the start of a tape (the frame native replay loads): every loaded chunk (chunks.bin.gz with per-chunk and 3x3 hashes), chunkstate.jsonl, entities in loadedEntityList order, pending block ticks, level.dat, worldstate scalars, every Det stream, both player files, as canonical typed NBT JSON; worlds.nbt also carries each PlayerManager's inhabitedTime clock (pmSweep, pmInst). "sub" writes an end-state snapshot under the tape's directory (test_snapshots compares its chunk inhabitedTime after the last row). Runs on its own thread while the server is parked.
used_by: {"cmd":"run","class":"Snapshot"} as a script's first command (make script / make -C oracle script DEV=1 ...)
oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/ServerTickProbe.java, SpawnProbe.java, SpawnDump.java, SpawnDumpDim.java, Checkpoint.java, SurvivalSetup.java, Dev.java and others (reuse its writers)
notes: entities.jsonl also carries what NBT does not for three kinds: an EntityDragon's flight state ("dragon": target, ring buffer, animation, the healing crystal's id, ticksExisted and the living counters, the box, the seven parts), an EntityEnderCrystal's innerRotation and health ("crystal"), an EntityThrowable's ticksInAir, ticksInGround, thrower id and ticksExisted ("throwable"); player_client.nbt's fields carry the S06s still in the client's receive queue (pendingS06: the join's first health update of a hurt player). The two oracle/src files that name Snapshot (NetHandlerPlayClient, S20PacketEntityProperties) use the unrelated vanilla nested class S20PacketEntityProperties.Snapshot, so there are no vanilla hooks. Also records Collections.shuffle's static Random state (det.nbt 'shuf') per DEVLOG. det.nbt also carries 'furnace' (BlockFurnace.field_149933_a of furnace and lit_furnace: state, and gauss when a nextGaussian is cached), and player_server.nbt's fields carry nextStepDistance and distanceWalkedOnStepModified. stats.json (Stats.state): the StatisticsFile and the client mirror. Since the any-tick sweep (lane/anytick) a snapshot can be taken at any tick (Oracle --snap-at on a replay) and carries each entity's runtime (rt, EntityState.java), its tracker entry (trk) and chunk slice index (cidx); clientents.jsonl (the client world's entities); chunkstate tilesrt (tile entity fields NBT leaves out); player_client.nbt rt, ctl (PlayerControllerMP) and pending (every received packet not yet processed); player_server.nbt rt, netrt (NetHandlerPlayServer), iiw (ItemInWorldManager), sendQueue (EntityPlayerMP.loadedChunks), mirror/openMirror (Container.inventoryItemStacks); and a save/ overlay of every chunk the run saved (SaveOverlay, from a seed start too). The 3x3 chunk hash reuses each chunk's bytes as zero runs. lane/anytick: worlds.nbt carries each world's Teleporter (tpRand, tpCache in destinationCoordinateKeys order); an open ContainerMerchant records its merchant (the villager's id or the client's recipe list, trList) and InventoryMerchant's index and recipe (trIdx, trCur); the tracker entry's fields are trkrt beside lane/bot5's trk and trkd; a sweep snapshot (overlay) deflates at BEST_SPEED. lane/keyframes: dump prints ORACLE SNAPSHOT TIME (ms per part). Blob mode (cmd "blobs", set by Oracle --snap-at for the keyframes and the any-tick sweep): each chunk's bytes are written once per run as BLOBDIR/<own hash>.gz and a snapshot lists them in chunks.idx and saved-chunks.idx (cx cz hash near path), its chunkstate, saved-chunkstate, entities and clientents as .jsonl.gz. Speed (gold-g13, 3.5-4.0 s a snapshot before, 0.3-1.5 s after): fillChunkBytes reads the section arrays directly (Probe.fillChunkBytes's bytes, checked equal on every chunk of four gold-g13 snapshots); primePow is two 1024-entry tables; the 3x3 hash is cached for the run by its nine chunks' own hashes (nearCache) and the changed ones, with every chunk's fill and own hash, run on up to eight worker threads (prehash, parallel); the Nether's and End's region chunks are read from the region file's stored payloads, decoded in parallel only when the payload changed since the run's last snapshot (savedCache, readSaved), their bytes kept deflated between snapshots; findField caches the accessible Field per class and name. lane/oracletick: chunks.bin.gz and saved-chunks.bin.gz are written by a thread per stream (ChunkOut: the same calls on the same stream, in order; the loaded chunks' queue is unbounded, their bytes being held by fillCache, a region chunk's is bounded at 64), and dump finishes both after its last phase; Filled.cut's segment arrays are sized by the segment count with int zero-run lengths (it allocated int[nnz+1] and long[nnz+1] per chunk). seedticks.jsonl.gz reads every unloaded chunk the region headers hold, after the chunks the pending set points at (lane/structscenes): a due entry of an unloaded chunk leaves the pending set, so a spawn-area chunk saved with ticks at the join can have none near it and still re-add its TileTicks at its load.
